integrity: All proof certificates and two reproducible verification programs accompany the claim. The finite reductions and all prerequisites are stated directly; no external certification or independence is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact online-dimension formula is proved only for bipartite graphs with 1 to 31 edges. The 16-edge splitting lemma relies on a mathematically complete degree reduction and an exhaustive 57,786-case computer enumeration independently repeated by a second implementation. No assertion is made for 32 edges or larger; historical priority is not established exhaustively.
title: A dyadic half-edge theorem and optimal online shattering for bipartite edge concepts through 31 edges
